protocol.method: Manual, agent-authored drafting grounded in the full text of the indexed corpus, following the same evidence-first method as the development benchmark: a chunk is chosen because it contains the answer, and the question is then written from that chunk.
protocol.question_selection: Candidate chunks were located by scanning the stored TEXT of every chunk in the knowledge base with plain substring matching. No retriever was run: no vector search, no BM25, no reranker, no embedding call. Topics were chosen to avoid the concepts the 28 development questions already cover and to spread across all 11 corpus documents.
protocol.evidence_selection: Exactly one necessary chunk per question, inherited from the development benchmark's relevance model (binary, necessity-only). Every chunk must not appear in the development benchmark, and every question must be answerable from that single chunk alone.
protocol.review_policy: Every question is frozen as a DRAFT. A human must record an approve, edit or reject decision for each question in the review view before the artifact can freeze as VALIDATED. Until then it freezes as PROVISIONAL, which permits exploratory results only.
protocol.separation_policy: Separation from the development benchmark is measured, not asserted: no expected chunk may be shared with a development question, and every question is scored for lexical similarity against all 28 development questions. The measurements are recomputed by the validator and reported per question.
protocol.known_limitations: Lexical similarity cannot prove two differently-worded questions test different knowledge, and the agent that drafted these questions is the same agent that ran the V13 experiments, so a shared blind spot cannot be excluded by the drafting method alone. Only independent human review, and ideally questions authored by someone else, can address that.

authorship.method: agent-drafted from the full text of named indexed corpus chunks; no retrieval and no LLM generation
authorship.author: Buffy (Codebuff agent), operating under explicit human instruction
authorship.human_review: PENDING - see the review records on each question
integrity_rules: No question may reuse an expected chunk of a development question; the validator treats a shared chunk as an error, not a warning.
No question enters the frozen instrument without a verbatim evidence quote that the validator can find in the named chunk.
Every question is frozen as a draft; review decisions are appended by a named human in the review view and never by this script.
Recorded reference answers, key points and ground truth do not exist for these questions, so no answer-correctness claim may be made from them.
